steps.note: Aerated and stirred, the bacteria oxidise the lactose to lactobionic acid, with the pH held up by sodium hydroxide.

processing.text: The study used whey rather than permeate itself; its best batch reached about 21 g/l in 50 hours, and how the acid is then recovered is not sourced here.

links.name: Pseudomonas taetrolens lactobionic acid from whey (PMC4133020)

sources.text: The temperature, pH, inoculum and time are from this study of lactobionic acid made from whey by Pseudomonas taetrolens.
